Portland / Oregon

Upcoming in Portland

Punk, metal, goth, hardcore and other live music. Independent art, zines, DIY and unusual markets.

SHOWS is a music-first calendar for Portland's independent scenes. The mixed feed includes select art and DIY events, zines, and unusual markets—not routine farmers markets or a comprehensive city events feed. Coverage is evolving, and inclusion is not endorsement.

Dates and times reflect published organizer details and can change. Open the source listing to confirm before attending. Times use Portland's Pacific Time zone; unknown start or end times are identified in calendar exports. There are no accounts or behavioral tracking. Saved events stay in this browser.
